theme_central: True wisdom (hikma) begins with Tawhid, expresses itself in relationships (parents), practice (prayer) and character (humility) — conveyed through a father's advice to his son.
sources_note: 3-section ring structure precisely sourced (thequran.love, Exhaustive Exegetical and Thematic Analysis): 1-11, 12-19, 20-34.

branches.title: The Qur'an, wisdom and divine signs
branches.resume: The Book of wisdom, warning against futile speech, signs of creation.

children.t: The Book of wisdom, guidance and mercy for the doers of good
Warning against futile speech that turns people away from Allah's path
Paradise promised to the doers of good; the heavens without visible pillars

branches.title: Luqman's advice to his son
branches.resume: The heart of the surah: Tawhid, kindness to parents, prayer, patience, humility.

children.t: Wisdom given to Luqman: "O my son, do not associate partners with Allah"
Kindness to parents, within its limits
The mustard seed seen by Allah, prayer, patience, humility in walking and speech

branches.title: Divine omniscience and sovereignty
branches.resume: Futility of idolatry, signs of day and night, closing on the five keys of the unseen.

children.t: Futility of idolatry in the face of the immensity of creation
Alternation of day and night, ships at sea by Allah's grace
Closing: the five keys of the unseen known to Allah alone
